name: Undead Horizon
detailed_description:
In Undead Horizon, the world as you know it is gone, and the undead are all that remain. A relentless horde of zombies threatens to overrun everything, and your only hope is to survive for as long as possible... together.

This co-op, round-based zombie survival game challenges you and your friends to fight off waves of the undead, earning points as you go. Use your hard-earned points to buy powerful weapons, perks, and upgrades that will help your team stay alive longer. Each round becomes more difficult, pushing your skills and strategy to the limit.

As you survive, you'll uncover hidden clues and story elements, unlocking a deeper mystery behind the outbreak and the world’s downfall. The question isn't just how long your team can survive—it’s what lies beyond the horizon, waiting to be discovered.

Key Features:

  • Co-Op Gameplay: Team up with friends to face the undead together in an intense survival experience.

  • Endless Waves of Zombies: Fight through wave after wave of relentless undead enemies.

  • Weapon & Perk System: Spend points to buy weapons and unlock perks to give your team an edge in battle.

  • Weapon Upgrades: Upgrade your weapons to make them more powerful and take on stronger foes.

  • Uncover the Story: Hidden clues throughout the game reveal a deeper story behind the zombie outbreak. How far will you go to uncover the truth?

Survival is the goal, but in Undead Horizon, it’s not just about lasting the longest—it’s about discovering what happens when the world ends, with your team by your side.
